Module com.example.demo
Package com.example.demo.ui.editor.tools

Interface FillCell

All Known Implementing Classes:
GrassTool, IgniteTool, RectangleSelectionTool, SelectionTool, SoilTool, TreeTool, WaterTool
public interface FillCell
Represents a painting tool used in the forest editor.
Each tool defines:
- the visual color used for preview - the type of ForestCell it creates when painting
